description: Recomputed the Kaniovski (2008) Theorem 1 Bahadur values with exact binomial sums in Python 3.12.1, to fix golden test fixtures.
outcome: n=3: M=0.57475, MB(0.55,0.4)=0.54505; n=5: M=0.5931269, MB(0.55,0.4)=0.5196194 (rounded to 7 decimals). Matches the values quoted in the Wikipedia 'Jury theorem' article.
